title: Activities
raw_text:
9/29/26, 10:16 AM
Using the submission run is recommended if you are processing large volumes of data.

Activities

1. On the SAP Easy Access screen, choose |/*Periodic Processing » For Contract Accounts » Submission for Collection
Submission Run 3 (transaction FPQ3DM).

2. Enter a date and an ID that you can use to identify the run later.

3. Restrict the selection of items to be submitted on the General Selections tab by business partner, contract account, and/or

company code. On the Additional Selection tab page, you can refine even further the selection of the items to be
submitted.

4. lf you set the relevant indicators on the Submission Parameters tab, you can also submit items that have been written off
and items that have been posted statistically. If you set the indicator Submit Additional Items, in addition to the items
released for collection, you can also submit all additional items of the business partner (See Submitting Receivables to

Collection Agencies).

If you work with debt recovery scores, you can enter a variant for checking the debt recovery score when you submit items.
5. Choose the collection agency that you want to submit the receivables to.

For submitting using files, to create a submission file, select the corresponding indicator and define a path under which the
file is saved. If you set the indicator Payment Form ID for Collection Agency, all items submitted for a business partner are
grouped under a payment form ID that the collection agency can specify as a payment reference in its report. If you set the
indicator Total Receivables to be Submitted, the items in the file are totaled by contract account, business partner, or
payment form.

For submission via Enterprise Service/API, during an update run, the system automatically sends the data relevant for
submission to the collection agency using Enterprise Services.

6. Schedule the program run. For more information, see Functions for Scheduling Program Runs.

The submission run records all submissions in logs. To ease the load on your system, you can delete these logs. To do this, on the
SAP Easy Access screen, choose |)»Periodic Processing » Delete Data » Logs of Submissions for Collection 3 (transaction
FPO3DML).
